request: leadCapture tenant model -- who supplies companyId for an anonymous public lead submission?
rationale: PRD explicitly states this lead has no existing companyId relationship: leads are captured from anonymous public visitors before any company relationship exists. Traced experimentally across three independent generation runs (docs/experiment1-leadCapture-evaluation.md) -- Database, Backend, and Frontend agents all independently assumed companyId was required and caller-suppliable, in three different concrete (and each vulnerable) ways, because decision_gate asserted it as a blanket rule with no per-module override.
evidence: tests/prd_leadCapture.json fields[].companyName.description: "This lead has no existing companyId relationship."
Experiment 1: public_lead_submission_connector allow-listed companyId from an anonymous request body.
Experiment 2: public_leadCapture_sp required companyId in the body, 400 if missing.
Experiment 3: public_leadCapture defaulted to companyId=1 if the anonymous caller omitted it.
constraints: Public submission endpoint must not read, accept, default, or validate against a client-supplied companyId.
companyId must not be a NOT NULL column tied to a public write path, and must not have a foreign key to companies.

If leads are later attributed to a company (e.g. by marketing-site API key or admin assignment), that attribution must happen server-side, outside the public request body, and is a separate decision from this one.
